description: This file is a shell script that tests the integration of Git and Perforce (p4), specifically focusing on handling of filenames and branch names with shell metacharacters (such as '$' and spaces). It includes setup of Perforce depot, file creation, Git operations, and tests for copying, deleting, and branching with special characters in filenames.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changelists to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 integrate
methods.description: Integrates changes between branches in Perforce.

methods.name: p4 branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in Perforce.

methods.name: p4 edit
methods.description: Opens files for edit in Perforce.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Configures Git settings, such as branch list.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Stages files for commit in Git.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to execute after test.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.
